from app.core.database import SessionLocal
from app.services.expense_service import ExpenseService

db = SessionLocal()
service = ExpenseService(db)

report = service.get_monthly_report(3, 2026)

print(''Trip expenses with enhanced descriptions:'')
for trip_group in report[''trip_expenses'']:
    trip = trip_group[''trip'']
    print(f''Trip {trip.id}: {trip.start_date} to {trip.end_date}'')
    for expense in trip_group[''expenses'']:
        print(f''  Expense {expense.id}: ""{expense.description}""'')
        if expense.leg_id:
            print(f''    (linked to leg {expense.leg_id})'')

db.close()
